bug.actual_behavior: A successful local-runner pass was rejected because an existing .DS_Store changed during execution.
bug.expected_behavior: The runner should ignore operating-system metadata changes or compare only task-owned paths while preserving user files.
bug.impact: 这是由 skill 设计缺陷导致的真实环境问题，需要纳入后续修复闭环。
reproduction_steps: Run the skill from a macOS project directory containing an existing .DS_Store.
Allow Finder or the filesystem to update that file while the skill is running.
bug.summary: Integrity check treats an automatically modified existing .DS_Store as an unauthorized path change
bug.workaround: Run the skill from a clean isolated directory inside the declared task workspace.
